last.verdict: Moderna swung to a profit on strong international COVID vaccine sales and raised its revenue outlook, but the profit rests on one seasonal quarter.

takeaways.label: Outlook raised
takeaways.text: Full-year 2026 revenue growth is now expected at 15%–25%, up from 'up to 10%'. Third-quarter revenue rose 29% to $1.3 billion, driven by international COVID vaccine deals.

takeaways.label: One-quarter profit
takeaways.text: Net income was $162 million versus a $200 million loss a year ago, helped by R&D spending down 27%. Nine-month net loss is still $1.96 billion.

takeaways.label: Cash jump is borrowed
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–$8.3 billion, up from $4.7–$5.2 billion, partly because of $2.6 billion in convertible note proceeds. Most third-quarter sales were still uncollected.

takeaways.label: Cancer drug win
takeaways.text: Phase 3 melanoma data for intismeran (with Merck) cut the risk of recurrence or death by 42%. Regulatory filings are being prepared. The norovirus vaccine's path is unclear.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
